notes_for_editor: Single-source story: the Alberta register supports the build year, size, location and active status. Two searches found no Alberta White Mountain lookout history. One search surfaced a Grande Prairie Museum story about an old Grande Prairie fire tower; the search snippet describes it as a training tower, and it does not link to this site, so it is not used. The Canada Lookouts White Mountain page has a heading only. Do not confuse this with the firelookout.ca 'White Mountain Fire Tower' record, which is an Ontario site near Tweed. The brief record's access 'closed' and staffing note ('staffed March-October') are not traced to any source I could read, so the story uses the register's drive-access flag.
